name: td-intents
description: TradeDesk Siri Shortcuts / App Intents bridge. The App Intents themselves (native/td-intents/ios/AppIntents/TdAppIntents.swift) run IN the App target, not this plugin's pod, since Shortcuts/Spotlight only discover intents declared in the host app. This plugin is just the drain: an intent's perform() stashes a route in UserDefaults.standard (shared in-process with the app, no App Group needed), and JS reads it once on boot exactly like a cold-launch push tap (js/push.js lastTap).
